items.question: A live instrument shows that about half of the order flow the absorption tracker drops is lost because a watched price level falls outside the 10-level order book the tracker sees, although the level still exists. A separate approved change will rebuild the full-depth book from a raw feed but still hand the tracker only 10 levels, and a 24 h probe measured that this makes the same kind of close 2.7 times more frequent. What should the follow-up fix be?

options.label: (a)
options.text: hysteresis: keep the episode open while the level is out of view, with the level's size unmeasurable during that time (freeze or skip it)

options.label: (b)
options.text: give the tracker more than 10 levels from the full-depth book the raw-feed change already rebuilds; no new subscription, the other order-flow indicator is untouched; unmeasured, so run a pre-registered probe arm before any build

options.label: (c)
options.text: subscribe a 20-level 100 ms book feed; the other order-flow indicator reads the same ladder and would change too

options.label: (d)
options.text: decide only after the raw-feed change ships, from a fresh read of this instrument on the raw feed

items.rationale: (b) removes the cause rather than bridging it, and the raw-feed change alone makes the cause worse. (a) reports a size nobody can see. (c) moves another indicator. (d) defers into a dataset boundary that (b) avoids paying twice.

items.question: About 27 % of absorption episode closes, carrying 31 % of the dropped flow, happen when the best price trades through the watched level without a break-tolerance breach. Flow arriving after such a close is classed as pressing, not a break, by the tracker's own trade rule. What should happen to this close reason?

options.label: (a)
options.text: write a derivation of what the level's size trajectory means while the touch is through the level, then decide

options.label: (b)
options.text: treat these closes as legitimate and change nothing for this reason

options.label: (c)
options.text: add a fix option now: a crossing without a break-tolerance breach does not close the episode

items.rationale: The evidence says the crossing is not a break by the tracker's own rule, but keeping an episode open across a crossed touch measures the level from the wrong side of the book. That needs a derivation, not a guess.
